programmes.title: A Love Glimpse
programmes.description: An incident upends the lives of Qamar and her fiancé, Nabil, threatening the peace of the entire family. Conflicts and traps intensify between them, but a love story is born from the heart of these successive challenges between Qamar and Bahr. Bassel Khaiat, Karmen Bsebas, Michel Hourany, Hossam Ali, Rafi Wahbi, Jifra Younis, Marah Hasan, Jafra Younes, Carmen Bsaibes, Pierre Dagher, Randa Kaady.

programmes.title: Kuwait Riyadh Kuwait
programmes.description: Al Onoud, a secondhand goods seller who travels frequently between Riyadh and Kuwait, gains sudden fame after a viral video and is soon proposed to by Moteab, triggering escalating family tensions. Fouz Al Shatti, Muhammad Al Ramadan.

programmes.title: Governorate 15
programmes.description: Against the backdrop of a fractured political landscape, Lebanese citizens and Syrian refugees face a harsh human struggle, where daily hardship meets the fight for survival, and endurance itself becomes a form of victory. Karin Rezq Allah, Yorgo Chalhoub.

programmes.title: September Breezes
programmes.description: Roula returns to her home in a rural Syrian village, where her grandmother, Umm Fawaz, still lives. Unexpected events force her to stay longer than she thought, and her life converges with youth and the elderly in her village. programmes.title: With Love
programmes.description: Trapped by the fear of losing her son, Mayar agrees to find a temporary husband to appease her dangerous and controlling ex-husband.
